name: When is the best time to start home repairs if I plan to sell in a few months?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to start home repairs if I plan to sell in a few months?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's best to start home repairs as soon as you decide to sell, ideally 2-3 months before you plan to list your home. This allows ample time for planning, material procurement, completion of repairs, and any necessary touch-ups without feeling rushed. Starting early provides flexibility for unexpected delays and ensures your home is market-ready when the optimal selling season arrives. City Dweller, LLC can assist with project scheduling for homes in Daly City, Pacifica, and surrounding areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start home repairs 2-3 months before listing to allow ample time for planning, completion, and any unexpected delays, ensuring your home is market-ready.
